strategies.overview: Duosion is a unique special wall, that has access to Future Sight and an excellent Special Attack, making it the best Future Sight user. Thanks to its ability Regenerator and decent bulk, Duosion checks specially offensive Pokemon such as Girafarig and Ivysaur while offering many opportunities for its teammates to break through defensive backbones with the help of Future Sight. Duosion also has access to Magic Guard, which is useful in a metagame where entry hazards are dominant, and can use setup moves like Calm Mind and Acid Armor, letting it fulfill the role of a setup sweeper.
strategies.comments:
Other Options

Trick can be used if all of your Pokemon dislike losing their items, thus, enabling Duosion to act as a Knock Off absorber against weak Pokemon such as Tinkatuff and Thief users like Dusclops and Dunsparce. Duosion can run Magic Guard in teams that have no way of dealing with entry hazards, but it is generally outclassed by Regenerator otherwise.

Checks and Counters

Dark-types: Dark-types like Scraggy and Krokorok are completely immune to Duosion's STAB moves and do not fear being paralyzed either. Stunky also threatens Duosion, but it dislikes being paralyzed.

Steel-types: Steel-types such as Hisuian Sliggoo and Tinkatuff can take on Future Sight with ease, preventing Duosion from making progress.

Physically Offensive Pokemon: Thwackey, Raboot, and Choice Band Piloswine all force out Duosion by threatening it with powerful STAB moves.

Psychic-types: Psychic-types like Hattrem and Girafarig with Shadow Ball check Duosion, as they do not fear Future Sight or Night Shade. Girafarig, especially, can use Duosion as a setup opportunity if it runs Substitute + Nasty Plot and Duosion is not running Encore.

Knock Off: Knock Off users such as Servine and Ivysaur significantly hinder Duosion, as Eviolite is needed for it to effectively wall foes and to fire Future Sight without needing to waste a turn healing.

Drakloak: Despite Duosion being a special wall, it fears Drakloak's Ghost STAB moves.

movesets.name: Defensive Pivot
movesets.description:
Duosion is used as a special wall thanks to its decent bulk and Eviolite, checking specially offensive Pokemon such as Girafarig, Ivysaur, and Hisuian Sliggoo. Duosion's most unique tool is Future Sight; in combination with its excellent Special Attack, Duosion can break through defensive cores. For immediate damage, Duosion runs Psychic to threaten Pokemon like Monferno and Glimmet. Duosion can also use Night Shade to hit Steel- and Dark-types like Tinkatuff and Krokorok consistently. Duosion has access to utility moves like Thunder Wave to hinder offensive Pokemon that would want to aggressively come in on it such as Raboot and Thwackey. Encore is a secondary option to not let Pokemon such as Fraxure and Substitute + Nasty Plot Girafarig set up on Duosion. Regenerator is the preferred ability due to allowing Duosion to not need to waste a turn healing with Recover when coming on passive Pokemon such as Koffing and Quaxwell.

Duosion fits best in balance teams that have a good offensive synergy with it. Duosion's offensive teammates like the help of Future Sight to break through defensive backbones with ease, especially Pokemon that cannot hit Poison-types such as Monferno, Scraggy, and Thwackey. In return, Monferno checks Thwackey and Scraggy, which are two Pokemon that threaten Duosion. Additionally, Pokemon with Knock Off such as the aforementioned Monferno, Scraggy, Thwackey, Pignite, and Krokorok, pair well with Duosion since they can remove the foe's Eviolite to let Future Sight hit them for even more damage. Pokemon such as Fletchinder and Raboot that can pivot on Pokemon like Quaxwell, Koffing, and Glimmet are appreciated, as it gives an opportunity for Duosion to use Future Sight. Physically defensive Pokemon like Koffing and Quaxwell appreciate Duosion's ability to wall specially offensive Pokemon like Girafarig and Hisuian Sliggoo. Despite being a special wall, Duosion cannot deal with Drakloak, so it appreciates other Pokemon like Scraggy and Dunsparce beating it. Additionally, Pokemon that can absorb Knock Off like Dunsparce, Tinkatuff, and Koffing cover Duosion's weakness to it. Pokemon with U-turn can quickly overwhelm Duosion, so Pokemon like Koffing and Mareanie that can take U-turn and check offensive pivots are appreciated, as well as Fletchinder and Seadra, which punish U-turn thanks to their abilities Flame Body and Poison Point, respectively. Duosion cannot hit Dark-types if not running Night Shade, so Pokemon that can check Scraggy like Monferno, Fletchinder, Clefairy, and Pignite, or Pokemon that take on Krokorok like Dunsparce, Piloswine, and Thwackey are appreciated. Furthermore, Duosion struggles to damage Steel-types if not running Night Shade, so using Ground-types like Krokorok and Piloswine or Fighting-types like Monferno and Pignite to prevent them from absorbing the upcoming Future Sight makes for a good combination. In the same vein, Mareanie can lure Steel-types like Tinkatuff and all-out attacker Hisuian Sliggoo and take them down slowly with Infestation. Pokemon with access to Roar such as Quilladin and Piloswine pair well with Duosion's Future Sight, having a chance of forcing in Pokemon that do not want to take a hit from Future Sight. In case Duosion is not running Encore, Pokemon that deal with Girafarig's Substitute are desirable, such as Scraggy and Hisuian Sliggoo.
